turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, Doctor. Thank you for seeing me, I really appreciate you taking the time. I, um... I hope I'm in the right place, and I certainly don't want to sound like a complainer or anything. 

I'm a computer support specialist, and... well, for over a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to take this situation at work seriously. It's regarding the new ticket rotation and these recent security audits. I... I really believe they're being used to build a paper trail against me. 

I know that probably sounds a bit unusual, doesn't it? I really don't want to cause any trouble at the office. Management keeps showing me the system logs and, you know, they keep saying it’s just standard policy. But it just doesn't feel like that's the whole truth. 

Am I making sense so far? I just want to make sure I'm explaining things properly for you.

symptom_reasoning.S019: The patient expresses a persistent belief that work policies and audits are being used to build a paper trail against them, maintaining this belief even when management provides contradictory evidence (system logs).
